bullets: FVOA says PFinn is the only team in the league that would be favored against a historically average team (+0.3), and the other nine all sit below that line. PFinn is 1st in both FVOA and the standings, with ~92% to make playoffs and ~42% to grab the 1 seed.
Barrett had the biggest odds swing of the week, up ~47 points to ~87% to make playoffs. He is now the 2nd strongest team, has the best strength of record, and has a ~26% shot at the 1 seed himself.

Bobby left 47 points on his bench, the most in the league this week, because KC at QB put up 29.3 while Bal gave him 0 in the lineup. He also leads the season in points left on the bench at 140, so the 10th strongest team is doing it to himself, and he has a ~36% chance of finishing last.

Bobby and Eric (~32% for last) play each other next week in a game FVOA rates as the least interesting on the slate, with Eric a 52% favorite. It's a battle for the cellar and nobody should have to watch it.

Diaz is 4-4 with a ~38% playoff chance, but the Chris game swings that to ~69% with a win or ~15% with a loss. Justin is 5-3 in 5th place but only the 6th strongest team, which is why he sits at ~30%.
commish_corner: Commish took the league's biggest fall in FVOA, dropping 3 spots to 4th, and his playoff odds slid ~14 points to ~61%. Next week against Justin is the highest-leverage game in the league, with ~86% to make playoffs on a win and ~24% on a loss, and he is a 54% favorite. It doesn't help that he left 17.4 points on his bench, 2nd most this week, including KC at WR with 11.3 while LV gave him 0.
